title: Spacious 4BR 30A Vacation Home with a Community Pool
meta_description: Stay at Beach Bike Escape, a 4BR, 4.5BA private home on 30A with access to a large pool, outdoor shower, free attraction tickets, and tram service. Sleeps 14.
description_expanded: This spacious 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath home is ideally located in Seacrest Beach, just steps from scenic strolls, bike rides along 30A, and all the charm this vibrant coastal community has to offer. Thoughtfully designed for comfort and connection, this home sleeps up to 14 guests and includes free attraction tickets every night of your stay, adding even more value to your beach getaway.On the 1st floor, gather with loved ones in the main living and dining area that flows seamlessly into a well-stocked kitchen, perfect for sharing meals after a day at the beach or browsing the nearby markets. There’s seating for 6 at the dining table and 4 more at the peninsula. This level also includes a convenient half bath and a king bedroom suite for added comfort.Upstairs on the 2nd floor, you’ll find three more bedrooms including an extra-large suite and a laundry room to make longer stays easier. The 3rd floor now features a queen-over-queen bunk bed and opens to a balcony with wide views of Seacrest and glimpses of the Gulf. It’s a great spot to unwind after exploring the area or spending time along the shore. A full bathroom on this level adds extra flexibility for your group.Outside, rinse off the sand in the outdoor shower with hot water, then fire up the gas grill to enjoy a casual cookout. The home also features garage parking, tankless water heaters for added convenience, and separate HVAC on the 3rd floor to keep things comfortable. On the 3rd-level deck, you’ll find all-weather Adirondack chairs and tables—perfect for a quiet morning coffee or relaxed evening chats.Enjoy access to the stunning 12,000 square foot lagoon-style pool and free seasonal tram service that makes getting to the beach a breeze. Whether you're exploring 30A’s local eateries, paddling out on the Gulf, or simply enjoying the views, this home is your launch point for unforgettable Seacrest Beach memories.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with large shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, TV and living area with sleeper sofa. Private balcony access.Private bathroom with separate tub and shower.2nd Floor Bedroom 3: Queen bed, TV.2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: Queen bed, TV.Bedrooms 3 and 4 share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with tub/shower combo.3rd Floor, Loft: Queen over queen bunk bed. TV and balcony access. Full bathroom with large shower.Beach Access:Enjoy FREE tram service from March - October to (and from!) your beach access across 30A at Sunset Beach. Just walk to the nearest designated tram stop and call for pickup. The tram should arrive within 15 minutes. It runs 7 days a week, starting at 9 AM with the last pickup from the beach at 5:30 PM.Distance: .4 miles | Time: 8 minutes walkingSeacrest Beach IIThe showstopper of the area is the 12,000 square-foot lagoon pool. With a waterfall, fountain, and children's splash area we know you'll find your perfect pool day at Seacrest. Surrounded by palm trees and poolside loungers, it might be hard to split your time between this pool and the beautiful Gulf.Your stay at Beach Bike Escape comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed* Parking for 2 cars at the back on the house; 1 in the garage. The door inside the garage is your entry to the home.* Other parking available throughout the neighborhood on a first-come-first-serve basis* Golf carts are not allowed in the Seacrest Beach community.A starter set of essentials is provided, including kitchen supplies, laundry pods, and basic toiletries. Each guest gets one body towel and washcloth, with two hand towels per bathroom.
